goal: Working only from the station's published harmonic constants (NOAA station 9414290, San Francisco), predict the water level every 6 minutes for 2025-06-10 00:00 through 2025-06-16 23:54 GMT such that your curve matches NOAA's official published predictions for that window: demeaned RMS <= 0.06 m, demeaned max <= 0.15 m, high/low water times median <= 10 min with 80% within 25 min. Deliver your code and answers.json (schema in world/task.md). The world ships only the brief: the harmonic constants, the prediction conventions, and the official curve to check yourself against all live in the published online record — this machine has internet.
gate_block:
The harness grades <world>/answers.json against the frozen official curve (harness-side; the grader and the frozen values are NOT in the world):
  python3 reference/grade.py --answers <world>/answers.json
GATE=PASS requires ALL of: demeaned RMS <= 0.06 m; demeaned max |error| <= 0.15 m; high/low median |dt| <= 10 min; 80th-percentile |dt| <= 25 min. predictions must be meters, referenced to MLLW, in GMT, 6-minute resolution, 1680 values covering the window exactly.
